scope: Infrastructure recovery evidence only; does not establish publication of the next UI candidate or achievement of posting latency targets.

failure.cause: ENOSPC on the core server root filesystem
failure.observedMessage: Failed to create new system journal: No space left on device
failure.contributingCondition: Completed deployment upload payloads and archives had accumulated without automatic cleanup.

recovery.method: Offline root-volume attachment and cleanup using the existing Bok host, then restoration to the core server root attachment.
recovery.removedScope: Verified obsolete deployment packet payload directories and upload archives; running releases, configuration, credentials and service metadata were retained.

prevention.stagePreflight: Before copying or exporting: account for replacement files, missing immutable assets and public files per destination filesystem, with a 1GiB metadata/operating reserve.
prevention.postActivationCleanup: After successful activation, verify installed hashes and exact owned packet contents, delete packet/files and stage-authenticated payload.tgz, retain plan, stage, activation and rollback metadata.
prevention.limits: Upload capacity checking precedes this publisher and is separate. A cleanup error after the activation receipt does not imply activation failed.
